name: observational-memory
description: Replaces compaction with observational memory: a background Observer (GPT-5.6 Luna via pi) turns each ~10k-token chunk into prioritized, attributed observations and a Reflector condenses them, so compaction cuts at the observed point with no model call. It keeps the user's constraints verbatim, a continuation record and a code-compiled brief where observation lags; om_recall searches the full transcript; om_stats and /om-stats report usage.
